metadata.description: Full verification and front-end ASIC benchmark report for 1x1 and 2x2 scalable TinyML NPU architectures

tests.name: Reset Recovery & Pin Handshake Verification
tests.description: Verifies rst_n recovery, default pin directions (uio_oe=0xE2), npu_ready=1, npu_busy=0

tests.name: Single-Cycle Signed INT8 MAC
tests.description: Computes 8 * 9 = 72, verifies single-cycle accumulation without latency skew

tests.name: Negative Saturation & Non-Linear ReLU Activation
tests.description: Computes (-12) * 5 = -60, verifies hardware ReLU saturation to 0

tests.name: 4-Tap Vector Dot-Product with Scaled Requantization
tests.description: Computes dot-product of length 4, applies half-integer rounding (+2) and shift-right S=2 to yield 23

tests.name: Multi-Class Winner-Take-All Classifier
tests.description: Evaluates scores for Class 0 (40), Class 1 (150), Class 2 (60); selects Class 1 as winning index

tests.name: End-to-End MIT-BIH ECG Arrhythmia Inference
tests.description: Streams 16-sample PVC heartbeat against 3 templates (Normal=-35, PVC=+85, PAC=+15); detects PVC (Class 1)

tests.name: 2x2 Array Reset Recovery & Zero State
tests.description: Verifies synchronous reset and zero initialization across all 4 PEs (PE00, PE01, PE10, PE11)

tests.name: 4-PE Concurrent Single-Cycle MAC
tests.description: Row acts [8, 5] and Col wgts [9, 7] yield concurrent PE outputs [72, 56, 45, 35]

tests.name: PE Readout Multiplexer Channel Select
tests.description: Verifies 4-to-1 readout multiplexer selecting individual PE outputs correctly

tests.name: 4-Channel Parallel Requantization & ReLU
tests.description: Applies rounding offset and shift S=1 with ReLU yielding [18, 21, 32, 37]

tests.name: Dual-Template Arrhythmia Inference (2x Speedup)
tests.description: Normal template on Col 0 (-25), PVC template on Col 1 (+155) evaluated concurrently in 2 cycles

code_coverage_summary.uncovered_branches_note: Reserved instruction opcode 2'b11 bias load higher address bits for future multi-tile expansion

mutation_summary.note: All 6 synthesizable modules exceed the 85% mutation score threshold
